correctness.rationale: The homomorphism law forces a common additive map L by a telescoping-difference identity; every endomorphism has a unique F(a,b)=(La+t(b),Lb+s). The rank polynomial counts occupied affine quotient cosets per output component using falling factorial times Stirling number, with independent components; the gap bound and endpoint coefficient follow from singular rank. Exact finite brute force at q=2,d=1 and independent normal-form checks through q=2,d=2 corroborate but do not substitute for the universal proof. All d>=1 and all primes are covered.
